svg.title: High-availability deployment
svg.desc: Behind an nginx gateway, any number of stateless orchestrator replicas share one SQLite job store in WAL mode and claim jobs under renewable leases, so a crashed instance's jobs are re-run elsewhere with the same seed.

text.tspan: Claim order: priority, then fair share, then FIFO, under capacity.
